svg.metadata: Boundary refinement: dedicated Andorra ~100-point WGS84 GeoJSON contour, cross-checked against geoBoundaries AND ADM0 metadata/bounds; illustrated treatment: JOURNEY ATLAS

g.desc: GSHHG 2.3.6 intermediate-resolution sampling covers the entire aspect-fitted viewport as continuous inland land. Andorra is landlocked between France and Spain; the pale full-frame context therefore represents surrounding foreign land while the approved Andorra target remains dominant and unchanged.
